title: Does the local learning coefficient predict grokking difficulty? A small SLT probe

original_idea.body: Does the local learning coefficient predict grokking difficulty? Uses devinterp LLC estimator on a toy modular-arithmetic transformer (extends arXiv:2512.00686, arXiv:2603.01192).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Predicting capability phase transitions is safety-relevant but the link from LLC-on-toy-models to dangerous-capability prediction has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses devinterp library + toy transformer; some SLT conceptual depth needed but guided execution feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused LLC-vs-grokking-onset scatter; training across moduli adds some workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Foundational SLT probe, open tooling, weak lab incentive; independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Toy models with open LLC estimator; modest training across moduli.

novelty.reasoning: Extends a recent SLT paper; cross-moduli independent check is a partly-open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent SLT hypothesis; cross-moduli replication may be open.
